prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Guide Screen: Add a dedicated controls walkthrough screen right after home intro showing visibility toggles, movement commands, and taskbar options. (why: Support receives frequent queries about being unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Flow Moved After Friend Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet, building engagement before asking for account details. (why: Sign-in currently takes a high mean time of 567s and placing pet selection earlier builds motivation to complete sign in.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Upload Assistant Hint: Display real-time lighting and contrast advice on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failing or generating incorrect visuals.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Centered Path Selection Choice Cards: Re-layout the path selection screen into clean centered spotlight cards for preset vs custom pets. (why: The path choice screen has a high mean duration of 514s and drop-off rate of 23.8%.)
4: [choose_path, notification] Story Screen Onboarding Progress Indicator: Display step counts and progress indicators right from the initial story screen. (why: Overall funnel conversion is low (19.6%), and setting expectation early reduces early drop-offs.)

scores.note: High drop-off at finish step (35.2%) backed by frequent support queries, but requires building a new screen.
Sign-in step has high duration (567s), but evidence relies mainly on funnel metrics without direct support complaints.
Adoption has the biggest drop-off (39.1%) and direct support complaints about upload issues.
Address 23.8% drop and high duration on initial choice step, though support tickets do not explicitly mention it.
Progress indicator provides general clarity but targets a step with relatively low drop-off.
